name: MonarchFormActionsBar
title: FormActionsBar
summary: The Save and Discard bar of a form, for the bottomBar of a Scaffold, with unsaved, pending and error states and a confirmation before discarding.
whenToUse: At the bottom of an edit screen with a long form, so Save and Discard stay in reach while the form scrolls.
whenNotToUse: For a dialog or a short form put the buttons at the end of the form or in the dialog's actions. For a top app bar with a Save action use the TopAppBar actions slot.
api: @Composable fun MonarchFormActionsBar(dirty: Boolean, onSave: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, onDiscard: (() -> Unit)? = null, pending: Boolean = false, confirmDiscard: Boolean = true, hideWhenClean: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, status: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchFormActionsBarLabels = MonarchFormActionsBarLabels(), windowInsets: WindowInsets = BottomAppBarDefaults.windowInsets, actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchFormActionsBarLabels(unsaved: String? = null, save: String? = null, saving: String? = null, discard: String? = null, discardTitle: String? = null, discardDescription: String? = null, discardConfirm: String? = null, keepEditing: String? = null)

options.name: dirty
options.description: Whether the form has unsaved changes. Save and Discard respond only while it is true.

options.name: onSave
options.description: Saves the form. The app sets pending while it runs and error if it fails.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the bar. It fills the width.

options.name: onDiscard
options.description: Reverts the form. When given, a Discard button is shown.

options.name: pending
options.description: A save is running: Save shows progress and announces "Saving", Discard is off.

options.name: confirmDiscard
options.description: Asks before discarding, in an AlertDialog with a danger button.

options.name: hideWhenClean
options.description: Shows nothing while there are no changes, no error and nothing pending.

options.name: error
options.description: The message of a failed save, shown in the danger color in place of the status.

options.name: status
options.description: Replaces the "You have unsaved changes" text.

options.name: windowInsets
options.description: The insets kept clear, the navigation bar by default. Pass WindowInsets(0) when the bar is not at the bottom edge.

options.name: actions
options.description: More actions placed before Discard, for example a ghost MonarchButton.

states.name: clean
states.description: Save and Discard are disabled and no message is shown.

states.name: dirty
states.description: Both respond and "You have unsaved changes" is shown and announced.

states.name: pending
states.description: Save shows a progress indicator and the state "Saving"; Discard is disabled.

states.name: error
states.description: The error replaces the status in the danger color, with the error semantics, and is announced.

states.name: confirming discard
states.description: An AlertDialog asks "Discard unsaved changes?" with "Discard changes" (danger) and "Keep editing".

states.name: hidden
states.description: With hideWhenClean, nothing is composed while there is nothing to save or report.

appearance: A full-width surface-coloured bar with a 1dp subtle line along its top edge, the message in muted text above the buttons, and the buttons aligned to the end: Discard as a ghost button, Save as the primary button. The dialog uses the raised background. Each role has its own value in the dark and high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: iOS ships nothing for this entry and puts Save and Discard in the navigation bar; Android builds the bar because a bottom bar is where Android forms keep these actions on long screens. The web's onSave returns a promise that drives the pending and error states; in Compose state is hoisted, so the app sets pending and error itself. Without onSave the web button submits the surrounding form; Compose has no form element, so onSave is required. The web's sticky positioning is the Scaffold bottomBar's job here, and the web's named region (aria-label "Form actions") has no Android equivalent, so the bar is a traversal group without a name. The web's warning glyph before an error is not drawn, because Monarch for Android bundles no icons; the danger color is not the only cue, the text says it.
accessibility: The message line is always present and is a polite live region, so "You have unsaved changes" and an error are announced when they appear.
An error also carries the error semantics.
Save and Discard are MonarchButtons with 48dp touch targets; disabled ones are announced as disabled.
While pending, Save keeps its place and announces "Saving" as its state.
The confirmation is a Material 3 AlertDialog, which TalkBack announces and which Back dismisses.
The message wraps, and at large font sizes Save takes the width that is left and its label wraps instead of being cut.
edgeCases: Save with dirty false and pending false does nothing even if the button is reached.
If the app changes dirty to false while the confirmation is open, the dialog stays until it is answered; Discard then calls onDiscard.
The confirmation state survives a configuration change.
With confirmDiscard false, Discard calls onDiscard at once.

examples.title: Unsaved changes
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    MonarchTextField(
        value = name,
        onValueChange = { name = it },
        label = {{name.label}},
    )
    MonarchTextField(
        value = email,
        onValueChange = { email = it },
        label = {{email.label}},
    )
    MonarchFormActionsBar(
        dirty = name != saved,
        onSave = { saved = name },
        onDiscard = { name = saved },
        labels = MonarchFormActionsBarLabels(unsaved = {{unsaved}}, save = {{save}}, discard = {{discard}}),
        windowInsets = WindowInsets(0),
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    MonarchTextField(
        value = name,
        onValueChange = { name = it },
        label = "Workspace name",
    )
    MonarchTextField(
        value = email,
        onValueChange = { email = it },
        label = "Contact email",
    )
    MonarchFormActionsBar(
        dirty = name != saved,
        onSave = { saved = name },
        onDiscard = { name = saved },
        labels = MonarchFormActionsBarLabels(unsaved = "You have unsaved changes", save = "Save changes", discard = "Discard"),
        windowInsets = WindowInsets(0),
    )
}

examples.title: In a Scaffold
examples.setup:
var saved by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("Rook") }
var name by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("Rook") }

examples.title: A failed save
examples.code:
MonarchFormActionsBar(
    dirty = true,
    onSave = {},
    error = "Your changes could not be saved. Try again.",
    windowInsets = WindowInsets(0),
)
